description: This file defines classes and methods for automating checkout-related interactions in the Notesnook project, including navigating plans, pricing, coupons, and country selection, using Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: CheckoutModel
classes.description: Represents the checkout page model, providing methods to navigate and retrieve plans and pricing.

classes.name: Plan
classes.description: Represents an individual plan on the checkout page, allowing to get its title and open it.

classes.name: PricingModel
classes.description: Represents the pricing section, providing methods to wait for elements, get prices, apply coupons, and change country or plan.

methods.name: CheckoutModel.goto
methods.description: Navigates to the checkout URL with optional period and coupon parameters.

methods.name: CheckoutModel.getPlans
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available plans, excluding those starting with 'Education'.

methods.name: CheckoutModel.getPricing
methods.description: Returns the PricingModel instance after waiting for it.

methods.name: Plan.getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title text of the plan.

methods.name: Plan.open
methods.description: Opens the plan and returns the PricingModel for it.

methods.name: PricingModel.waitFor
methods.description: Waits for the change plan button to be visible.

methods.name: PricingModel.waitForCoupon
methods.description: Waits for the coupon to be applied and the coupon element to be attached.

methods.name: PricingModel.waitForPaddleFrame
methods.description: Waits for the Paddle iframe to load.

methods.name: PricingModel.getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the pricing section.

methods.name: PricingModel.getPrices
methods.description: Retrieves a list of price items with labels and values.

methods.name: PricingModel.applyCoupon
methods.description: Applies a coupon code and waits for it to be reflected.

methods.name: PricingModel.changeCountry
methods.description: Changes the country and optionally the pin code, submitting the form and waiting for confirmation.
